run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T00:43:22Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend is explained by a configuration-only rollout of Deployment otel-demo/shipping at 00:42:02, which changed the shipping container env QUOTE_ADDR from the valid URL "http://quote:8080" (ReplicaSet revision 1, shipping-75d58f5d84) to "quote:0000" (revision 2, shipping-5ffdc77bc8) while keeping the same image tag. After that rollout, shipping's outbound POST span (operation "POST ") fails in ~10µs with Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat))) and its server span /get-quote returns Internal Server Error; checkout PlaceOrder then fails with gRPC status 13 and frontend POST /api/checkout returns HTTP 500. Frontend, checkout, shipping and frontend-proxy error-span rates were 0 for every sampled point from 00:25 to 00:43 and jumped at the 00:45 point (frontend 377.8, checkout 188.5, shipping 191.3, frontend-proxy 188.9 error spans per 5m) and stayed elevated through 00:55, matching the alert start 00:43:22. A pre-rollout trace at 00:41:55 shows the same calls succeeding (shipping "POST quote" 2.1ms, quote POST /getquote 358–410µs, checkout→email HTTP POST 200, email POST /send_order_confirmation 200, frontend POST /api/checkout 200). No flagd fault flag was on, no otel-demo pod crashed or restarted, and no other otel-demo workload's pod template changed in the window. Affected entities with their own failure evidence: frontend, checkout, shipping, frontend-proxy and load-generator (failed POSTs). quote and email were checked and showed no error signal, but they stopped receiving traffic once checkout began failing at the shipping-quote step. Recovery is not certified and no remediation was executed.

claims.text: Deployment otel-demo/shipping's current pod template sets container env QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000" (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping); the quote Service in otel-demo exposes TCP port 8080 only, so the correct target is quote:8080 and "quote:0000" is not a valid URL.

ReplicaSet comparison shows the change: shipping-75d58f5d84 (deployment revision 1, created 2026-11-18T00:05:31Z, replicas 0) had QUOTE_ADDR="http://quote:8080", while shipping-5ffdc77bc8 (revision 2, created 2026-11-18T00:42:02Z, replicas 1) has QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000"; both use image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping, i.e. a configuration-only template change.

Kubernetes events record the rollout: Deployment otel-demo/shipping ScalingReplicaSet "Scaled up replica set shipping-5ffdc77bc8 from 0 to 1" at 00:42:02Z and "Scaled down replica set shipping-75d58f5d84 from 1 to 0" at 00:42:09Z, with ReplicaSet SuccessfulCreate (00:42:02Z), ReplicaSet SuccessfulDelete (00:42:09Z) and Pod "Stopping container shipping" for shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q (00:42:09Z).

Only otel-demo/shipping was rolled out in the window: it is the only workload in the namespace with a revision-2 ReplicaSet (shipping-5ffdc77bc8, created 00:42:02Z, replicas 1); every other otel-demo ReplicaSet with replicas>0 is at revision 1, and all 21 otel-demo pods are Running with all containers ready and restartCount 0 (shipping pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn created 00:42:02Z, restarts 0).

After the rollout, shipping's own spans fail: in sampled frontend error traces the shipping server span /get-quote is error with otel.status_description "Internal Server Error" (63–70µs) and its child outbound span with operation "POST " fails in 10µs with otel.status_description "Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))", i.e. the outbound request URL could not be parsed, which matches the invalid QUOTE_ADDR value in the revision-2 template.

The failure propagates upward with each affected service's own error spans: frontend POST /api/checkout and POST return http.status_code 500 with otel.status_code ERROR, frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder returns rpc.grpc.status_code 13, checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder returns status 13 with otel.status_description "shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500", and checkout's HTTP POST to shipping carries error status.

Frontend is failing on this incident window: at 00:50:00 the frontend service had 2.874 ERROR-status span calls/s versus 50.656 UNSET/s (5m rate), and over the 42 minutes to 00:56 frontend error spans were concentrated on the checkout path — POST 428.4, POST /api/checkout 428.4, "executing api route (pages) /api/checkout" 428.4 and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 428.4 — while GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, grpc CartService/GetCart and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error increases were 0.

Error-span rate timeline (5m increase, sampled points): frontend, checkout, shipping and frontend-proxy were 0 at the 00:25, 00:27, 00:29, 00:31, 00:33, 00:35, 00:37, 00:39, 00:41 and 00:43 points, then frontend 377.78 / checkout 188.46 / shipping 191.27 / frontend-proxy 188.89 at the 00:45 point, and elevated (frontend 539.99, 888.89, 862.22, 813.33, 639.75) through the 00:55 point, consistent with onset shortly after 00:43:00 and the alert time 00:43:22Z.

Pre-rollout baseline at 00:41:55–00:41:58Z shows the same call path healthy: shipping /get-quote 2.16–2.24ms with outbound span "POST quote" 2.05–2.10ms, quote POST /getquote 358–410µs plus calculate-quote, email POST /send_order_confirmation http.status_code 200, checkout HTTP POST 200, frontend POST /api/checkout http.status_code 200 — no error spans in those traces.

quote and email lost their callers rather than failing: span counts per 5m for quote moved from 726.7–636.7 (00:25–00:33 points) to 280 at 00:45, 56.4 at 00:47 and 0 from 00:49; email moved from 968.9–848.9 to 373.3 at 00:45, 75.2 at 00:47 and 0 from 00:49.

No flagd fault flag was switched on: the flagd-config ConfigMap (key demo.flagd.json) contains adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure, all with defaultVariant "off"/0 (state ENABLED).

email recorded 1922 spans in the 40 minutes ending 00:56 and all of them carry status_code STATUS_CODE_UNSET (no ERROR-status spans); a sampled pre-rollout trace shows its POST /send_order_confirmation returning http.status_code 200.

Pod-level failures are not the mechanism: all 21 otel-demo pods are Running and ready with restartCount 0 and no last-termination state, and the replaced shipping pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn was created by ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 with 0 restarts (a controller rollout, not damage), while shipping's own container logs show repeated "Requesting quote" lines with no error text.

Other otel-demo services show no error increase in the same window: accounting, cart, payment 0 at every sampled point; ad and fraud-detection only ~1.1 error spans per point (flagd EventStream noise), recommendation 0–1.1; currency and product-catalog produced no ERROR-status series at all and their spans in the failing traces carry rpc.grpc.status_code "0"/otel.status_code OK.

Rejected: that the email service's own HTTP 500s caused the frontend errors, even though checkout's gRPC status text reads "shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500". Sampled failing traces contain no email spans, email's POST /send_order_confirmation returned 200 in the pre-rollout baseline, email recorded no ERROR-status spans (1922 spans, all UNSET), and email traffic stops once checkout aborts at shipping; the failing outbound span in those traces belongs to service shipping and fails URI parsing.

Rejected: fault-flag injection through flagd as the cause of the frontend errors. Every flag in the flagd-config ConfigMap (including paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, cartFailure, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, emailMemoryLeak, kafkaQueueProblems, imageSlowLoad) is set to its off/0 variant, and the failing dependency is shipping's own QUOTE_ADDR environment value rather than a runtime flag.

Recommend (human action, not executed): restore Deployment otel-demo/shipping's QUOTE_ADDR to a full URL on the quote Service port, e.g. "http://quote:8080" as in the revision-1 template, then confirm shipping /get-quote outbound spans carry no InvalidUri error and frontend POST /api/checkout returns 200 before considering the alert resolved.

gaps: Change history is not integrated in this Run, so who or what applied the QUOTE_ADDR change to Deployment otel-demo/shipping, and the exact instant of the spec edit, could not be verified; the timing is inferred from ReplicaSet revision records and events (template revision 2 created 2026-11-18T00:42:02Z).

The Prometheus rule named RequestErrorRate was not returned by list_prometheus_rules (view ecd7bfe1-7a4a-45dd-ba07-b30124d1a9d9-t1:5f38715c-24f2-41d5-a6a9-e4c53f2b7d6b, status no_data), so the alert's expression, threshold and label mapping could not be verified; the firing labels came only from the Alertmanager payload.

kube-state-metrics series were unavailable: get_metric_names for {__name__=~"kube_.*"} (a55d42c5-d04d-49e0-9f1f-a784b10a672c-t1:24007b4a-8dd1-4560-8f60-74e0b025daa7), kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="otel-demo",owner_name="shipping"} (27f2b82a-224d-4684-b49f-be9a78d96b0e-t0:96b71b9b-3f13-4ab3-8738-b51b1e96c120) and kube_pod_container_info{namespace="otel-demo",pod=~"shipping.*"} (27f2b82a-224d-4684-b49f-be9a78d96b0e-t1:6afd8194-b66f-4969-aeb8-eccb4f26fde8) all returned no data, so container image digests could not be compared between the old and new shipping pods; template identity rests on the identical image tag 2.1.3-shipping.

Log absence is unknown, not healthy: the email pod log query (pod email-59f69bc6cf-zwpwn, filter err|fail|500|exception, 00:40–00:56) returned no lines, 0 bytes read (49e5a160-7383-4ac7-871a-b70f19e26bd9-t1:cb4b9f7c-b4ff-43fb-bf67-b9d099c884ef, status no_data); the quote pod log query (quote-6b5877698d-6spfl, filter err|fail|exception|500, 00:20–00:56) matched no lines of 846 read (f8d3e500-534a-4834-8f81-5dd6aa597079-t1:df1e8246-b882-4fca-a85b-86595fa94e36, status no_data); and the checkout pod log query (checkout-5dccddf8bb-7gfz7, filter err|fail|shipping|quote, 00:40–00:56) matched no lines of 748 read (49e5a160-7383-4ac7-871a-b70f19e26bd9-t0:b17ada66-69c1-4af8-a658-58ff13dadf5d, status no_data). These stdout streams therefore do not corroborate the fault.

The provenance of the string "failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500" inside checkout's shipping-quote error path could not be verified (no source access); it is not confirmed whether the "email service" wording is a reused message template. Observed evidence shows no email span in failing traces and a 200 from email pre-rollout.

Events in the data-recorders namespace during the window (Pod FailedScheduling, PVC Provisioning/ProvisioningSucceeded/ExternalProvisioning/WaitForFirstConsumer, Job Completed/SuccessfulCreate, StatefulSet SuccessfulCreate, Deployment ScalingReplicaSet, PersistentVolume VolumeFailedDelete) were not investigated and no evidence ties them to the otel-demo error path; they are recorded as an unexplained change in the window.

Telemetry is sampled and some views were incomplete: traces_search for frontend hit RESULT_TOO_LARGE (unadopted), traces_search_by_tags for frontend returned as many traces as requested (e07367b8-f57e-4cbb-b02a-7b4bb560d289-t1:cc9ccec4-d2c7-4f9d-8c67-2db602d59687, incomplete), shipping log reads were limited to the newest lines (e07367b8-f57e-4cbb-b02a-7b4bb560d289-t0:8b5ee81b-1147-4507-8c3e-5923fa648250 and 054a7405-45e9-44d3-8357-e8e3cb01c336-t0:5fbbdcaa-f65c-401b-8ae1-684fd2ce81f9, incomplete) and the email trace search returned as many traces as requested (7f4cbaec-1f67-4aa1-a802-fd608ccc82d1-t1:c4678999-aed9-43e2-9a4b-8555f52075dd, incomplete); span counts are not unique request counts, so no complete call chain or full failure rate is claimed and the impact list covers only entities whose own error spans were observed.
next_steps: Review the rollout record/CI pipeline that produced Deployment otel-demo/shipping revision 2 at 2026-11-18T00:42:02Z to identify the source of QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000".

After correcting QUOTE_ADDR, watch shipping /get-quote error spans, checkout PlaceOrder gRPC status 13, frontend POST /api/checkout HTTP 500 and the RequestErrorRate signal to confirm the error rate returns to its pre-00:43 baseline of zero.
Confirm the RequestErrorRate alert rule definition in the alerting stack that produced the Alertmanager payload, since it is not present under that name in this Prometheus.
